core.notes:
Appearance › Fonts: System default (system-ui, what the game menu uses) and Claude app style, a 105% text size and an Open letter spacing between Normal and Loose; Control Panel remembers the last sub-tab of each main tab
Appearance › Fonts: Calibri and Segoe UI (your own computer's faces), a Text size option (90–120%) and a Letter spacing option; AWOO+ text now has slightly more space between letters by default, so Nunito no longer looks squeezed
Control Panel: feature settings have their own Feature settings entry in the sidebar; while it is open, the features that are on are listed right under it, by kind and category
Control Panel › Features: calmer lists with Minimal, Normal and Descriptive views, a few words after each name, categories for Tweaks that fold (one button folds or opens them all), a Reorder button, a clearer Load/Off and a larger settings button; Disable all and Reset to defaults sit at the bottom and ask first
Control Panel › Tweaks: Tweaks that belong together sit under one head with one switch for all of them, and a part of a feature is listed right under it
Control Panel › Features: the short summary sits beside the name and shows in full on hover; Normal also shows the developers when the panel is wide enough; Descriptive shows one Description column instead
Control Panel: clearer section headings (accent colour with a line under them), tighter rows, and every text box and dropdown has a visible border
Control Panel size can also be changed under General › Options
Feature pages: a one-line header, and Defaults and Reset sit at the bottom of the page
Control Panel: what sits under a heading is indented a step; pick how headings look under Appearance › Control Panel › Headings (Line under, Short line, Side bar or Band)
Feature settings list: categories are plain labels with their features indented under them, and only features that are on and have settings are listed
Nunito is now the text font too, in AWOO+ and the tools (once for everyone; pick another under Appearance › Formatting)
Appearance › Formatting: a font change shows on all of AWOO+ at once, and is dropped if you close without saving; Discard and Save always show, greyed when nothing changed
Section headings: an accent bar on a soft band (Appearance › Control Panel › Heading band turns the band off)
Control Panel: a setting changed from its default gets a small mark at its left edge (hover it for the default)
New installs start with the Tyrian theme (your own choice is never changed)
Control Panel › Features: the Developer column shows every developer as a short code (for example apz wbl), in the order they are listed; features built in show nothing there
Control Panel › Features: in Minimal view the Enabled, Menu, Bar and settings columns stay at the right edge like in the other views; the settings button is smaller and always centred
Control Panel › Features: a yellow note when more modules are ticked for the top bar than the limit in Appearance › Menu; the Disable all and Reset buttons stay at the bottom of the window
Menu: hovering All Tweaks lists every Tweak, with no descriptions: on ones in the normal colour, off ones in grey
Notifications: the size can be set to 120 % (now the default, with 100 % still marked), reminders that stay on screen can be turned off, and the sample notifications no longer stay or enter the history
New installs start with these settings: notifications bottom middle for 5 s (50 kept in the history), UI scale 105 %, local time, the letters of large numbers dimmed, and tooltips a little quicker (existing choices are never changed)
Fonts: your font choice now reaches all of AWOO+ (the game forced its own font on every element, so only some parts changed); new choice Match game (JetBrains Mono)
Large-number letters (k, m, b, qa and so on): coloured at once and consistently, also in figures that update every second, and lighter on the game's own page
The AWOO+ bar no longer makes the game's own top bar slightly taller
Control Panel: a setting changed from its default now has a mark in every checkbox setting, a bit subtler, with a quiet note about it at the foot of a feature's page
Control Panel: Basic now also shows how long and how big notifications are; the rest of that page stays Advanced
General › Reset: Reset all saved data (asks first); Reset window sizes now asks first too
Welcome tour: one short version, four visual steps (Panels, Features, General, Tips); Features offers None, Minimal, Recommended or Custom with the categories as checks; it stays where you drag it, and Skip tour is on every step
Updates: check every hour, 2 hours (the default), 6 or 12 hours; AWOO+ remembers when it last checked and checks about a minute after the game opens when it is due (no more "once per page load" or "only when I ask")
Top bar: a highlighted button reminds you to switch to your one-script link while an old second AWOO+ script is still installed
Win rate: Dungeon Win Rate is now a Tweak and works on the Dungeon log page itself: a panel above the log shows the win rate, wins and losses since the last 1, 2, 3, 6, 12 or 24 hours, 3 days or all time. Choosing a range that reaches further back loads older entries for you, and Stop cancels it
Grid Overlay: Renamed from Sculpture Grid Overlay
Grid Overlay: New default grid size 120 % for a new player (a saved choice stays); the checkbox settings mark what is not at its default
Grid Overlay: Every mod now has its own colour (stats use the game's red, green, blue and orange) and "Mod colours" can be Soft, Normal or Vibrant; options renamed: Uniques one colour, Show/hide stats, Separate presets tab, Tile tooltips
